reuse.why: Reuses getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and NO_TEMPLATE_SQL, but copies the category-selection query and income-skip check instead of extracting a shared selection for the month-wide actions.

duplication.why: The SELECT of eligible categories and the is_income/isTrackingBudget skip are verbatim copies of set3MonthAvg/set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg, adding a fifth copy of the selection rule.

placement.why: The action lives in budget/actions.ts and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Simple and readable, but any change to which categories month-wide actions fill must now be made in one more place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: no shared selection helper exists in the tree to bypass; the copy follows the sibling pattern

disguised_duplication.where: the copied category query and income skip are verbatim, not disguised
